{{Quote|Smasher! Tighten those ropes!|A mimph team leader|<ref name="gwtm" />}}
'''Smasher''' was a [[mimph]] who lived on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]].<ref name="gwtm" /> In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="date">{{EwoksDate|the appearance of Smasher|[[Gone With the Mimphs]]}}</ref> Smasher and two other mimphs, led by a fourth, [[Masher]], captured the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]], with Smasher helping by tightening the [[Rope/Legends|ropes]] used to [[Prisoner/Legends|detain]] him. The group then brought Warrick back to their [[Mimph village|village]], where they presented the Ewok to the rest of the mimphs, who were all very impressed.<ref name="gwtm" />

The mimphs released Warrick after he defeated a [[hanadak]] that threatened the mimph village, and Smasher was later present when the mimphs bid him farewell. Smasher had [[Color/Legends|pink-and-white]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and wore orange [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] with a yellow [[Belt/Legends|belt]].<ref name="gwtm" />

==Behind the scenes==
Smasher appeared in "[[Gone With the Mimphs]]," the sixth episode of the [[Ewoks: Season Two|second season]] of the animated series [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']]. The episode was written by [[Linda Woolverton]]<ref name="gwtm" /> and aired on [[October 18]], [[1986]].<ref name="insider">{{InsiderCite|27|A Star Wars CELibration|A ''Star Wars'' CELibration}}</ref> "Gone With the Mimphs" does not specify which of the four mimphs of the capturing party is Smasher.<ref name="gwtm" />
